posts.text: I'm thrilled to share that I have completed the CREATE: Engineering Design Challenge at the University of Toronto. Throughout this five-day course, I was given the opportunity to become well-versed in the realm of big data and algorithms. During the course, I worked alongside like-minded peers who share the same ambition and love for math and STEM as I do.
